citations.title: Justin Hotard, President and CEO

sentences.text: Justin Hotard (born 1974) became Nokia's President and Chief Executive Officer on April 1, 2025, and is based at the company's headquarters in Espoo, Finland; he also serves as interim President of Mobile Infrastructure.
Nokia announced the transition on 10 February 2025, with the board appointing him to succeed Pekka Lundmark, who stayed on as an advisor through the end of that year.

sentences.quote: he was at Intel as Executive Vice President and General Manager, Data Center & AI Group. In this role, he was responsible for a significant expansion of Intel's data center and AI business.
sentences.text: He joined from Intel, where he was Executive Vice President and General Manager of the Data Center and AI Group, responsible for expanding that business, and previously led High-Performance Computing, AI and Labs at HPE and ran HPE Japan and China.

Earlier roles were at NCR Corporation, Symbol Technologies and Motorola, where he began as an engineer; he holds an MBA from MIT Sloan and a BS in electrical engineering from the University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign.

sentences.quote: Espoo, Finland - Nokia is holding its Capital Markets Day 2025 today and announcing its strategy to position itself to lead in the AI-driven transformation of networks
sentences.text: At its Capital Markets Day on 19 November 2025 Nokia set out a strategy to lead the AI-driven transformation of networks and simplified its operating model into two segments, Network Infrastructure and Mobile Infrastructure; Justin Hotard said Nokia "changed the world once by connecting people - and will again by connecting intelligence".
Tommi Uitto left as President of Mobile Networks on 31 December 2025, and from 1 January 2026 Raghav Sahgal became Chief Customer Officer and Patrik Hammaren President, Technology Standards.
Kristen Pressner, previously of Roche, started as Chief People Officer on 1 April 2026.

sentences.quote: Now Nokia CEO Justin Hotard, who had taken on the interim leadership of that division while he found a new executive team member, has appointed Emma Falck as president of Mobile Infrastructure, starting on 1 September.
sentences.text: Hotard held interim leadership of Mobile Infrastructure until appointing Emma Falck, from Siemens, as its president from 1 September 2026.
